svg.text: Five Views of the Same Production Engine

g.text: e.g. A short film about a barista…
their regular customer is an AI…
A young filmmaker wonders if AI
Embodies: Law 3 (every decision has a reason) · Law 5 (AI proposes, human approves)
Embodies: Law 1 (generation is a service call) · Law 4 (same engine, fewer knobs)
Embodies: Law 2 (nothing final until user says so) · non-destructive layers
Embodies: Law 5 (propose ≠ execute) · Reviewer as first-class agent
Embodies: Axiom 2 (every interface is a view of the same model)
Same underlying Production state. Switching views is instant. Changes in any view reflect everywhere.
Reviewer agent (magenta) and Consistency Contract (next step) are first-class in every view.
1. View choice is automatic per-persona but overridable in settings — never forces a user to fight the surface.
2. Reviewer appears in every view at a glance — production quality is not an afterthought, it's an ambient signal.
3. Every view reads from the same Production state. No view has its own copy. Switching is instant, lossless.
